name: PdxList
description:
A list bound to data, an array or a DataSource, with custom item templates, a loading overlay
and an empty state.

members.name: source
members.description: The data source to render from.

members.name: idField
members.description: Item field used as a unique key.

members.name: emptyTitle
members.description: The empty state's title. Empty: the list.empty component string, «No items».

members.name: emptyDescription
members.description: Description shown when the list is empty.

members.name: emptyIcon
members.description: Icon shown in the empty state.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description:
The list's accessible name, `aria-label` on the host, written on the `role="list"` element
(#1053): the host has no role, so a name left on it alone names nothing.

members.name: ariaLabelledby
members.description: The id of the element that names the list, `aria-labelledby` on the host, written the same way.

events.name: pdx-click
events.description: An item was activated, by a click or Enter/Space, in a `clickable` list: the item, its index, and its `id-field`.
events.detail: { item: T; index: number; id: unknown }

attributes.name: idfield
attributes.description: Item field used as a unique key.

attributes.name: emptytitle
attributes.description: The empty state's title. Empty: the list.empty component string, «No items».

attributes.name: emptydescription
attributes.description: Description shown when the list is empty.

attributes.name: emptyicon
attributes.description: Icon shown in the empty state.

attributes.name: arialabel
attributes.description:
The list's accessible name, `aria-label` on the host, written on the `role="list"` element
(#1053): the host has no role, so a name left on it alone names nothing.

attributes.name: arialabelledby
attributes.description: The id of the element that names the list, `aria-labelledby` on the host, written the same way.

slots.name: item
slots.description: Renders one item: a snippet `item(item, index)`.

slots.name: empty
slots.description: Shown when the list has no items: a snippet `empty()`.

cssParts.name: item
cssParts.description: An item's row, `role="listitem"`. A page of a larger source gives each its `aria-setsize` and `aria-posinset` (A3).

cssParts.name: overlay
cssParts.description: The loading overlay, drawn while the source loads.

cssStates.name: bordered
cssStates.description: `bordered` is set (the default): the list is framed.

cssStates.name: dividers
cssStates.description: `dividers` is set: a rule between items.

cssStates.name: loading
cssStates.description: Its source is pending: the host is `aria-busy` too (A4).

cssStates.name: empty
cssStates.description: It has no items, and is not loading.
